description: This test ensures that the 'SHOP NOW' button on the homepage navigates users to the store page.
steps: Verify that the page navigates to 'https://atid.store/store/'.
Verify that the store page displays a list of products.
expected_results: Clicking the 'SHOP NOW' button navigates to 'https://atid.store/store/'.
The store page displays a list of products available for purchase.
edge_cases: Verify behavior if the store page is inaccessible.
Check for broken buttons or links.
Ensure the button works across different browsers and devices.
Test with a slow network connection to ensure the page loads correctly.
Ensure the button is accessible for screen readers.
data_requirements: The 'SHOP NOW' button must be present on the homepage.
The store page must display a list of products.
The 'SHOP NOW' button must be enabled and functional.
dependencies: The 'SHOP NOW' button must be implemented on the homepage.
The store page must be accessible.
The website must be online and functional.
api_interactions: Monitor any API calls fetching product data on the store page.
performance_metrics: Measure the time taken to navigate to the store page.
Check for responsiveness of the 'SHOP NOW' button.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that the 'SHOP NOW' button is navigable using keyboard shortcuts.
Verify that the button has appropriate ARIA labels.
Check for sufficient color contrast of the button.
